authoredNote: The aha-design plugin has no charts judge, so this set is DS-authored from the surface's criteria and contracts/chart.json.

evals.prompt: Review this Report screen. The poll results are drawn as a hand-written `<svg>` with one `<rect>` per option, heights computed in JS, and value labels as `<text>`. The rest of the screen uses DS components and tokens.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.expected_output: C1 FAILs: the poll result is a hand-rolled SVG bar chart instead of `<aha-chart type="bar">`, a chart type the DS ships. Fix: render `<aha-chart>` with the option counts. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
